text:
Aisha: Heads up — Vercel preview for my docs PR #4523 is failing intermittently with EMFILE errors in the build logs.
Aisha: error excerpt:
```
Error: EMFILE: too many open files, open '/vercel/path/to/site/css/main.css'
    at Object.openSync (fs.js:... )
```
Aisha: The preview link is 404 because the build failed; CI shows 1/3 preview builds failed.
Leo: I ran into this last month; often a file-watcher or a plugin opens too many files. Can you paste the full build log?
Aisha: https://ci.internal/vercel/12345 — jump to the last failure and search for EMFILE.
Jen: Vercel won't let us set `ulimit`, so `ulimit -n` won't help remotely. Two quick things: try disabling file watchers in the build step or run a non-watch build locally to replicate.
Maria: Local repro for others: run a build instead of serve if you just want to reproduce the error:
```
pip install mkdocs mkdocs-material
mkdocs build
```
Maria: If you need to run locally and preview the site:
```
mkdocs serve -a 0.0.0.0:8000
# or with docker if you don't want to install deps locally
docker run --rm -p 8000:8000 -v $(pwd):/workspace python:3.11 bash -c "pip install mkdocs mkdocs-material && mkdocs serve -a 0.0.0.0:8000"
```
Dan: Is this PR blocking anything critical? We have the 23:30 UTC merge window tonight but can also do a manual merge if needed.
Aisha: It's mostly a small SDK snippet fix and a migration note. Prefer not to block staging deploys. If preview can't be fixed quickly, can we get a manual review + merge after linkcheck passes? @Jen any objections?
Jen: If linkcheck and unit tests pass (and the failing job is only the preview builder), I'm OK with a manual merge. Please add label `docs/preview-flaky` and open a follow-up issue to triage the root cause.
deploy-bot: build #789 finished with status FAILED — EMFILE in job `build:docs` (https://ci.internal/vercel/12345)
Leo: I'll bisect dependencies tomorrow morning. Suspect culprit: a plugin that traverses the site and opens many files (sphinx-copybutton or a minifier).
Aisha: Thanks — tagging reviewers: @Maria and @Leo for quick content check.
Maria: I'll do a quick content review now. If code examples are fine I can approve. If CI non-preview jobs pass we can merge and rely on post-merge Netlify recache.
Aisha: One more local tip — running `watchman watch-del-all` removed stale watchers for me when EMFILE came from watcher leaks.
Jen: Plan: Leo to investigate plugin, Maria to approve content, Jen to gate manual merge if linkcheck passes. Create follow-up issue `docs#201` assigned to Leo.
Aisha: I'll update the PR description with repro steps and add the `docs/preview-flaky` label.
Dan: Heads-up: if you merge during the merge window coordinate with the release channel so we don't trigger staging e2e concurrently.
Maria: Content LGTM :thumbsup:
Aisha: Thanks everyone — merging pending remaining CI jobs.
